item.title: Metrolink riders unsettled after object shatters train window
item.description: Passengers on a MetroLink train in St. Louis experienced a shattered window, causing panic and confusion, though no shots were fired and authorities are investigating the incident as property damage.

item.title: Flood warnings extended for Meramec and Big rivers in Missouri
item.description: River levels continue to rise along the Meramec and Big Rivers, prompting the extension of flood warnings across several Missouri communities Sunday. Minor flooding is currently occurring in areas ranging from Valley Park to Sullivan.

item.title: Man attacks boss after being fired at tow company: Police
item.description: A St. Louis Circuit Court judge signed an arrest warrant for a Florissant wanted for attacking his boss last week shortly after being fired from his job.

item.title: How soon could Cardinals' dynamic prospect Joshua Baez reach the majors?
item.description: Joshua Baez, a fast-rising outfield prospect in the Cardinals organization, emerged as a power-speed threat in the minors last season and has carried that momentum deep into spring training, raising hopes that he could soon be knocking on the door of a big-league promotion.

item.title: Where does slugger Blaze Jordan fit into the Cardinals' future plans?
item.description: Even after the offseason trades of Nolan Arenado and Brendan Donovan, the St. Louis Cardinals' big-league infield still projects to be a bit crowded entering 2026. But one of the organization's newer prospects, Blaze Jordan, hopes to eventually work his way into the mix as a corner infielder with prodigious power.

item.title: Man finally in custody for 2024 child porn case
item.description: A St. Louis man was arrested over the weekend for a 2024 child porn investigation.

item.title: Juvenile charged as adult for Florissant armed carjacking
item.description: A Jennings, Missouri, teenager will appear in St. Louis County Circuit Court Monday morning to face charges for an armed carjacking last fall.

item.title: Endangered Silver Advisory issued for missing 72-year-old
item.description: The Northwoods Police Department issued an Endangered Silver Advisory late Sunday night for missing woman with dementia.

item.title: Man accused of $7,000 burglary at Three Kings Public House
item.description: A Missouri man will appear in court Monday morning for stealing thousands of dollars from Three Kings Public House last week.
